verses.text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of the sons of Korah. You showed favor to Your land, O LORD; You restored Jacob from captivity.

segments.text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of the sons of Korah. You showed favor to Your land, O LORD; You restored Jacob from captivity.

verses.text: You forgave the iniquity of Your people; You covered all their sin. Selah

segments.text: You forgave the iniquity of Your people; You covered all their sin. Selah

verses.text: You withheld all Your fury; You turned from Your burning anger.

segments.text: You withheld all Your fury; You turned from Your burning anger.

verses.text: Restore us, O God of our salvation, and put away Your displeasure toward us.

segments.text: Restore us, O God of our salvation, and put away Your displeasure toward us.

verses.text: Will You be angry with us forever? Will You draw out Your anger to all generations?

segments.text: Will You be angry with us forever? Will You draw out Your anger to all generations?

verses.text: Will You not revive us again, that Your people may rejoice in You?

segments.text: Will You not revive us again, that Your people may rejoice in You?

verses.text: Show us Your loving devotion, O LORD, and grant us Your salvation.

segments.text: Show us Your loving devotion, O LORD, and grant us Your salvation.

verses.text: I will listen to what God the LORD will say; for He will surely speak peace to His people and His saints; He will not let them return to folly.

segments.text: I will listen to what God the LORD will say; for He will surely speak peace to His people and His saints; He will not let them return to folly.

verses.text: Surely His salvation is near to those who fear Him, that His glory may dwell in our land.

segments.text: Surely His salvation is near to those who fear Him, that His glory may dwell in our land.

verses.text: Loving devotion and faithfulness have joined together; righteousness and peace have kissed.

segments.text: Loving devotion and faithfulness have joined together; righteousness and peace have kissed.

verses.text: Faithfulness sprouts from the earth, and righteousness looks down from heaven.

segments.text: Faithfulness sprouts from the earth, and righteousness looks down from heaven.

verses.text: The LORD will indeed provide what is good, and our land will yield its increase.

segments.text: The LORD will indeed provide what is good, and our land will yield its increase.

verses.text: Righteousness will go before Him to prepare the way for His steps.

segments.text: Righteousness will go before Him to prepare the way for His steps.
